phase_A_continuation.selection: minimum r48d.selection_key over eligible certified candidates
phase_A_continuation.stop_positive: first nonterminal persisted state with no terminal candidate and a_star>=4, after independent replay of every produced candidate
phase_A_continuation.stop_negative: verified terminal before any a_star>=4 state

phase_B_only_if_phase_A_terminal_below_4.reachability: Every third-mutated exact 3-CNF must independently pass the canonical reachable_fixpoint route before pressure continuation.
phase_B_only_if_phase_A_terminal_below_4.dedupe: Deduplicate both mutated-original hashes and reachable-root hashes.
phase_B_only_if_phase_A_terminal_below_4.stop: first independently replayed a_star>=4 state or stronger no-candidate obstruction; otherwise complete frozen budget.
